## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/pr-watch.sh:282` — `DIRTY` → `conflict`; `:286` folds `BEHIND` into `mergeable` (the babysitter then blocks `human:merge` on a PR GitHub will not merge under a strict rule).
- `hooks/ledger.sh:897` — build stage takes `implement` entries with `.owner == null and .blocked_on == null`: a forwarded entry is picked up with no other change.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:901` — deploy stage takes `pr` entries unblocked or `human:merge`; a `conflict` entry is taken by no stage (the dead end).
- `hooks/ledger.sh:477-483` — implement attempts above 2 → `stall`; `reopen` resets `attempts = 0` (`ledger-lifecycle.sh:152`).
- `hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh:146-148` — a directive reaches the build lane, never the launched worker; the follow-up file is the way to hand a worker text.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:309-327` — `person_text_as_data <kind> <rule>`: reads unconsumed rows of `.<kind>[]`, path `$LDIR/$ID.<sfx>-<n>.md` derived (never read from the entry), re-hashes, dies on mismatch, wraps in nonce markers.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:373-376` — follow-ups consumed on `pr` or `blocked human:*`.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:378` — implement `pr` → `advance verify`; from `implement` that is forward, so a forwarded entry re-enters verify with no change to `advance`.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:396-418` — verifier: gate chain, FAIL → `verdict`, pass → `advance pr` + `block human:merge`.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:490` — implement schema; no `question` field; `blocked` → `block --kind K` without `--question` (`:379`).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:392-394` — the plan role already writes `$LDIR/$ID.question-<ts>.md` and passes `--question`: the pattern for FR-012.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:630-633` — a retry reuses `$TOP/.claude/worktrees/$ID`: the worker lands on the PR branch.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:572` — inside a worker, `block` cannot replace a `human:*` block with another kind.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:646` — `run` refuses inside a launched worker: the precedent for `forward` refusing under `HEFESTO_WORKER`.
- `hooks/lane-lib.sh:54` — person-only verbs; plain `forward` is NOT one (mechanical routing), but `forward … --past-cap` IS (spec D6, FR-005): the way past the cap is a person's.
- `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:135` — `block`, `advance`, `unblock` are lane ask rules; `forward` joins them as an **ask** rule (spec D3, FR-018 — consistent with `block --kind conflict`, which the interactive babysit already asks for); the headless launcher and the merge action call it from inside helpers, so no dialog there. Superseded: an earlier draft put it in the allow list.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Helpers die loudly with the value seen and the shape expected (`ledger-lifecycle.sh:139`, constitution 5).
- Files beside an entry are written with `rm -f` + `cp`, never through a link (`ledger-lifecycle.sh:150`).
- Entry writes go through `jq … | write_entry "$id"` and append an `.events[]` record (`ledger-lifecycle.sh:152-155`).
- Tests: sibling `tests/smoke-*.sh` sourced from `tests/smoke.sh:6794-6803`, each with a "source me" guard (`smoke-merge.sh:10-15`); fake `gh` answers from a JSON file (`smoke-merge.sh:28-45`); fake `claude` reads a result file (`smoke.sh:2400`); in-test mutations with `sed` on a scratch copy and `bad "mutation survived: …"` (`smoke.sh:4110-4120`).
- CHANGELOG: Keep a Changelog `[Unreleased]`, bold lead-in with ticket (`CHANGELOG.md:38-60`), checked by `hooks/changelog-check.sh`.

## Facts settled from GitHub semantics
- `mergeStateStatus: BEHIND` is reported only under a branch-protection rule requiring up-to-date branches; without it a behind PR is `CLEAN`. So no protection-API call is needed (spec D1).
